new: Back into the cell, Network tab: Share with this room puts your own network on the room's relay; everyone at the station sees it and changes its limits and picks together.
Outside a room, Put on the relay gives a link (#ppicell&explore&net=...). Remove from the relay takes it off; Back to the built-in network takes everyone back.
A headset's Network tab lists the networks on the relay by name and size. Nothing leaves a browser unless its owner presses Share.
A device that cannot fetch the room's network says why and shows the built-in one, without upsetting the room.
Still untried: v207's Network tab, v206 lining up a worn character, v205 the cell's sides and complexes, v204 to v200 (mirror robot, tour tables, sharp VR text, any mix of devices).
test: On the test place: a laptop and a headset at a Back into the cell station. On the laptop: Try an example, then Share with this room. Does the headset show it, and follow the laptop's limits?
In the headset: change a limit and pick a protein; does the laptop follow? Then open the example from the headset's list of networks, and Back to the built-in network.
v207: the Network tab's limits in a headset (smooth? frame rate at 8,000 links). v206: lining up a worn character. v205: Walls and Machines.
